description: Fires late in the game when the left edge is closed, meaning columns 0 and 1 are both full (more strongly when columns 2, 3 and 6 are full too), while column 4 and/or 5 is still open. Filling the last cell of column 4 or 5 switches it off. It also fires early when the opponent has an open three on the bottom row, giving two must-block cells. Many columns still open: no firing.
effect: Raises column 4 by about 0.2-0.3 probability when the unit is forced high, mostly at the expense of columns 3 and 5. Zeroing it at a top example moves about 0.16 from column 4 to column 5. No effect when the move is forced.
notes: Poisoned-column idea scored F1 0.08. Rules based on which columns are full scored 0.47-0.51 (best 0.507 with p8, sim share 0.23; p2 sim share 0.31). Minimal pairs: col0+col1 full gives 9-10, col1 only about 4.9, col0 only 0.7; filling col4 or col5 instead gives -1.5. The activation is not the game value. Toy boards without tactics only reach about 4, and the same board reached by a different move order varies (3.2 vs 1.9), so move order and tactics matter too. Misses include late boards with a whole column still empty.
